name: DWConv (depthwise Conv block)

whatIsIt.eli5: A cheap pattern finder that looks at each layer of notes on its own.
whatIsIt.simple: A Conv block (conv + batch norm + SiLU) whose convolution is depthwise: each channel is filtered separately (groups = gcd of input and output channels).
whatIsIt.engineer: Conv(c1, c2, k, s, g=gcd(c1, c2)) → BN → SiLU.

whyExists.eli5: Much cheaper than a normal pattern finder.
whyExists.simple: Cuts cost a lot; YOLO11/12/26 use it in the head's class branch, followed by a 1×1 Conv to mix channels.
whyExists.engineer: ≈1/c2 of a dense conv's MACs; spatial filtering without channel mixing.

eli5: Each layer of notes gets its own small window.
engineer: groups = gcd(c1, c2); equals c1 when c1 == c2.
